instruction: SCOPE: you are ONLY authorized to test https://vault.kervia.ch (this exact host, our own Kervia-vault secrets vault). Do NOT touch any other domain, IP, service or port on this network. Attack surfaces: REST API /v1/* (Bearer av_ keys), MCP /mcp, admin webui /ui/* and /admin/* (session cookie), first-boot setup /setup/*. Test: authentication (Argon2id keys, bcrypt login, recovery codes), access control (per-vault grants, IDOR), setup wizard, rate limiting, sessions, template validation, injection on REST/MCP inputs. No valid credentials provided: unauthenticated recon, auth bypass, logic flaws only. Do NOT brute-force (rate limits are intentional). Report findings with PoC.
